description.value: Once per campaign arc, if you would die while your Save is current, you instead restore from it at 1 Hit Point in the nearest safe space you have previously visited. You lose every memory formed since your last update — the GM narrates what that cost — and your Save is stale until you make a new one.

cinderfall.incomplete: Restoring from a Save at 1 HP in place of dying, once per campaign arc, has no engine hook: nothing lets a rule element intercept or override the built-in death sequence (same absence as Defy the Reaper), and 'Save' itself is a bespoke narrative-memory mechanic with no attribute anywhere in the actor schema.
